title: Fix, Don't Retake: Physics-Simulated Training for Correcting Patient Positioning Errors in Dental Panoramic Radiographs
abstract: arXiv:2611.21304v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Patient-positioning errors can distort panoramic radiographs and lead to repeat examinations. This study investigated artificial intelligence for correcting these errors in existing images. A physics-based simulator generated paired correctly positioned and mispositioned panoramics from cone-beam computed tomography volumes, with controlled individual and combined positioning errors. Five approaches were compared: U-Net, pix2pix, conditional diffusion, an error-conditioned model, and a mixture of error-specific specialists. Evaluation used image similarity and geometric metrics across three test sets. All approaches improved mean image similarity and reduced geometric errors, with U-Net and the two error-aware approaches outperforming pix2pix and conditional diffusion.

translated_title: 修复而非重拍：基于物理模拟训练校正牙科全景放射片中患者摆位误差
translated_abstract: 患者摆位误差会导致全景放射片变形，并引发重复检查。本研究探索了利用人工智能校正现有图像中此类误差的方法。研究构建了一个基于物理的模拟器，从锥形束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）体数据中生成配对的正确摆位与错误摆位全景片，并可控制地引入单独及组合的摆位误差。研究比较了五种方法：U-Net、pix2pix、条件扩散模型、误差条件化模型以及误差特定专家模型的混合。评估在三个测试集上采用图像相似度和几何指标进行。所有方法均提高了平均图像相似度并减少了几何误差，其中U-Net与两种误差感知方法的表现优于pix2pix和条件扩散模型。
tldr: 本研究利用基于物理的模拟器从CBCT生成配对的正确与错误摆位全景片来训练AI模型，可直接校正现有牙科全景放射片中的患者摆位误差，从而避免重复检查。
